description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. It filters log messages to only pass the message content downstream, omitting metadata like tags and priorities, primarily for simplified on-screen log output.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode interface that forwards only the message content to the next LogNode, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor that takes a LogNode to chain the output; sets the next node in the logging chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter()
methods.description: Default constructor; does not set the next LogNode.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Overrides the method to forward only the message content to the next LogNode, ignoring priority, tag, and Throwable.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
